body:
SKETCH v1 is posted on STORY-1689 (aida show STORY-1689 --comments).
Proposal: `aida dev build --if-main-green` as a 15m substrate job. The tick runs the quick fail-closed checks (dirty/off-main/unchanged/non-ff/CI red|pending|unknown/wave-pinned/in-flight), fast-forwards main, then launches the build in a detached systemd-run unit, because the 120s job timeout and 15min TimeoutStartSec rule out building inline. A failure is reported on the next tick via CronJobFailed:dev-autopromote and routed to advisor.
Also found: Forge::ci_status(CiTarget::Commit) is broken on GitHub and GitLab (unused today), so PR1 fixes it. 3 questions for you: detach vs timeout override, enabled-by-default, all-checks vs the CI workflow only.
subject: SKETCH posted (STORY-1689)
